propositions: An explicit `rebar review-plan --retry` CLI override reuses successful/resumed checkpointed findings from the latest INDETERMINATE review and re-executes only failed/cancelled/shed-budget units with a fresh attempt budget.

Retry eligibility requires the latest REVIEW_RESULT sidecar to contain a versioned discovery_journal with recomputed identity-digests matching current ticket material, effective policy, prompts, model/mode, topology, context, dependencies, and source; stale, corrupt, or legacy journals are refused before any model call.

Reusable findings are reconstructed via `sizing.load_checkpoint(ctx, digest)` keyed to the recomputed checkpoint_identity of each success/resumed unit; units with no matching stored envelope are treated as missing and re-run.

Pass-2 verification, coaching, and deterministic decision/assembly rerun over the combined reused and newly recovered findings; retry output exposes only established end-result fields without per-unit execution trace.
`--retry` is mutually exclusive with `--force`, `--status`, and `--check`; it remains compatible with `--no-sign` and preserves normal full-review behavior when absent.

Documentation is canonical in `review-plan --help`, generated reference, user guide, plan-review gate guide, and exit-codes.md explaining eligibility, fresh budget, reuse semantics, zero-call refusal, flag conflicts, and the full-review remedy.
